tested_hypotheses: gear::on_cast dispatches to tiger_tally::on_cast (crates/content/src/gear.rs); the stale 'not wired' status from v1 is superseded.

Admitted Redirect Skill and Ultimate casts each grant one wearer-only Normal damage instance and record a Left (Redirect) or Right (Ultimate) talisman deadline at cast + the frozen 15s window; Normal, QTE and role-less casts grant nothing.
Instances stack to 2 with independent 15s expiries; a third grant inside the window is dropped without refreshing survivors.
A same-side grant refreshes that side's talisman deadline; an opposite-side cast strictly before the stored deadline consumes the pair and immediately activates the wearer-only Arc bonus.

The Arc bonus refreshes one 10s wearer-only timed buff (Reset policy) and joins the additive M_bonus zone only against targets carrying the content-owned Boss status tag; it applies to packets of any input role. The Normal bonus stays restricted to Normal-role packets.
The static ATK bonus is base-scaled (static + base * bonus), verified by the 2150 vs 2300 counterexample in a real scenario run.
Exact expiry precedes equal-time queries (BuffManager rule: expired when now_us >= expires_at_us); the talisman pairing uses the strict inequality time_us < deadline.
Automatic Arc activation, pair consumption, same-side refresh, Arc Reset refresh and Boss-tag eligibility are bounded implementation hypotheses; the frozen text does not specify them.
Group THREE legality is enforced at projection; the ExclusiveCharacterIDArray is reported, not interpreted as an equip restriction.
The Critical Riposte clause is excluded (no engine action role or packet representation); buff_TigerTally_CD2 is a frozen row referenced by no DataList.
Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.
